card.title: Is the Tree Balanced?
card.sub: DFS with an Early Exit · Easy

a1.cap: A tree is height-balanced if, at every node, the heights of the left and right subtrees differ by at most one. Return true if the tree is balanced.

lines: A tree is height-balanced if, at every node, the heights of the left and right subtrees differ by at most one. Return true if the tree is balanced.

a1.cap: For example, with root = [3,9,20,null,null,15,7], the answer is true.
a1.say: For example, with root equals 3, 9, 20, null, null, 15, 7, the answer is true.

a1.cap: A helper returns a subtree's height, or −1 if it found an imbalance anywhere below. Each node checks its children's heights once, so the whole check is a single pass.
a1.say: A helper returns a subtree's height, or minus 1 if it found an imbalance anywhere below. Each node checks its children's heights once, so the whole check is a single pass.
